exact_statement: For every nonconstant uniform Boolean g with 0<p=P(g=-1)<=1/16, iteration of J=-h(x xor1) on six disjoint copies, stopped at the first minority probability above1/16, terminates at G with 1/16<P(G=-1)<1/4, E(G)>=E(g)-(3/16)log2(192e)>E(g)-111/64 and H(G)/I(G)<=H(g)/I(g)+45/22. E=min over relevant physical coordinates of H(S_i|S_-i)/Inf_i. Every step retains H(F)=Q H(g)+C, I(F)=Q I(g), C=H_p(J)-Q h2(4p(1-p)).
hypotheses: h is negative exactly on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40} in little-endian six-bit indexing.
All six copies at each step have disjoint physical inputs; entropy units are bits.
